1: O sovereign Lord, from every forest of the earth and from all its trees you have chosen one vine, and from all the lands of the world one region, and from all the flowers of the world one lily, and from all the depths of the sea one river — and you have made your people, whom you love, the least of all. Why, Lord, have you given the many to the few, and your name to the scorn of the nations?

For in truth there is no one among those born who has not sinned, and among the dead no one who has not done wrong. You, Lord, are the one who does righteousness, and the deeds of men are like the wind — and the wind does not answer for where it blows, and the heart does not answer for where it blows, and that is the sickness beneath the sickness.
2: [4 Ezra 7:60-61 — The present and the age to come]

For this reason, therefore, the Most High made not one world but two: this age, for the sake of the many who dwell in it, and the age to come, for the sake of the few. For as the sand is many and the pearls are few, and the years are many and the harvest-days are few, so the many walk toward the fire, and the few walk toward the light.

The day of judgement is decisive, and it displays the seal of truth to all. For then no one will be able to have mercy on him who is condemned, nor to condemn him who is acquitted — for the measure of that day is true, and the scale of that day is just, and the Judge of that day has already carried our sorrows once, and knows their weight.
3: For this age the Most High made, but the age to come He made ready: it is a harvest, and the harvest is for those who sowed in tears. Do not question the ways of the Most High any longer — for the farmer waits for the rain, and the rain does not explain itself, and the waiting is itself a kind of sowing.
[4 Ezra 14:22 — The restoration of the words]

For the world lies in darkness, and its inhabitants are without light; for your law has been burned, and therefore no one knows the works you have done, or the works that are yet to be done. If then I have found favour before you, send the Holy Spirit to me, and I will write down everything that has happened in the world from the beginning — and Ezra wrote, and the words returned, and the light came back to the world with them.
